runtimeMapping.ordinaryAttack: One live legal victim, retained if still selectable at .667/min(1,ASPD/100); replacement at release. Original homing speed10 and lifetime10. Fired source-independent projectiles read current ATK at impact.
runtimeMapping.duetto: Original selectMethod2 maps first cast to buff[a] and later casts to buff[b]. Cast count resets on deployment. Selected ASPD addition and later ATK formula1 percentage combine additively with Pyrobreath.
runtimeMapping.ignition: Original active RES final-scaler buff applies only to trace target before damage. Radius1.5 pass includes trace target, then extra end-buff AdvancedApplyDamage applies atk_scale_2 to it. Separate ranged NORMAL Arts receipts share attack identity. Selected charge cap; SP blocked through reserved windup. Dead input refunds only when no replacement shell was emitted.
runtimeMapping.volcano: Mode1 chooses distinct random legal current range occupants, capped by selected attack@max_target. Empty animKey plus mode animator exclusion maps to immediate projectile release every (1.6-1.1)*100/ASPD seconds; native signal/dispatch overlap is not executable frame evidence. Original speed6 parabolic mover maps to shared XY homing. Front Skill_Start/Loop/End stance also substitutes for original Back missing those clips.
runtimeMapping.pyrobreath: Caster mask32, target-free ignored, DEFAULT nonindependent key and atk priority. Highest present source supplies additive ATK percentage to deployed casters including self. Controls do not detach the aura; source death/retreat does.
runtimeMapping.wildFire: ON_OWNER_LOCATE RandomSetter convertToInt=false maps to seeded continuous [sp_min,sp_max). Ordinary ModifySp respects noSp and total-charge cap. One draw per deployment.

verificationLimits: Native compiled random-selector maximum routing, RandomSetter distribution and ModifySp downstream rounding remain unrecovered. Fractional range SP is an explicit local mapping of convertToInt=false; PRTS displayed integer endpoints do not establish compiled rounding.

S3 empty animKey and waitForAttackEvent1 coexist with a mode hook excluding ordinary Attack and skill skeletons without OnAttack signals. Immediate release, begin/end overlap and FSM restart cadence are local choices, not recovered executable C# or frame parity.

S2 sequence follows original active-buff/projectile/end-buff graph and authored PRTS notes. Equal-priority cancellation, lethal-area extra-hit skip, dead-input replacement/refund and interruption resumption are tested local mappings, not compiled native callback order.

Animated MUZZLE/HIT coordinates and S3 parabolic height are unmapped. Shared XY homing collision and default glyphs do not reproduce original particles, splash effects, audio or every foreign projectile interaction.

Aura override priority and same-frame membership use shared lifecycle events. Duplicate same-character squad/support is unavailable. Modules, native Unity effects and recorded game-frame parity remain unsupported.

sourceReferences.notes: Authored mechanics notes checked through browser source: per-deployment Duetto history, radius1.5, main-only RES, area then extra trace damage. Native random/SP and S3 dispatch remain explicitly bounded.
